stages.name: nodes
stages.query:
SELECT *,kind||':'||__start||':'||__end AS id,
 parent_kind||':'||parent_start||':'||parent_end AS parent,
 ancestor_kind||':'||ancestor_start||':'||ancestor_end AS edge_parent,
 row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY __path,parent_start,parent_end,parent_kind ORDER BY __start,__end,kind)-1 AS ordinal
 FROM raw_nodes

stages.name: edges
stages.query: SELECT __path,edge_parent AS src,id AS dst,ordinal FROM nodes WHERE edge_parent IS NOT NULL

stages.name: functions
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.name_source AS name FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='function_definition'

stages.name: ownership
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE owned(__path,id,fn,cls,top_fn) AS (
 SELECT n.__path,n.id,CASE WHEN n.kind='function_definition' THEN n.id END,CASE WHEN n.kind='class_definition' THEN n.id END,CASE WHEN n.kind='function_definition' THEN n.id END FROM nodes n
 LEFT JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=n.__path AND parent.id=n.edge_parent WHERE parent.id IS NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT child.__path,child.id,CASE WHEN child.kind='function_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.fn END,CASE WHEN child.kind='class_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.cls END,CASE WHEN owned.top_fn IS NULL AND child.kind='function_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.top_fn END
 FROM owned JOIN edges e ON e.__path=owned.__path AND e.src=owned.id
 JOIN nodes child ON child.__path=e.__path AND child.id=e.dst) SELECT * FROM owned

stages.name: classes
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.name_source AS name FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='class_definition'

stages.name: methods
stages.query:
SELECT f.*,c.id AS cls,c.name AS class_name FROM functions f JOIN classes c ON c.__path=f.__path
 WHERE f.parent=c.body_kind||':'||c.body_start||':'||c.body_end OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes d WHERE d.__path=f.__path AND d.id=f.parent AND d.kind='decorated_definition' AND d.parent=c.body_kind||':'||c.body_start||':'||c.body_end)

stages.name: attributes
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.attribute_source AS attr,n.object_kind||':'||n.object_start||':'||n.object_end AS object,n.object_source AS object_text FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='attribute'

stages.name: calls
stages.query: SELECT n.*,f.id AS callee_id,f.kind AS callee_kind,f.text AS full_callee,coalesce(a.attr,f.text) AS callee,a.object AS receiver FROM nodes n JOIN nodes f ON f.__path=n.__path AND f.id=n.function_kind||':'||n.function_start||':'||n.function_end LEFT JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=f.__path AND a.id=f.id WHERE n.kind='call'

stages.name: arguments
stages.query: SELECT n.*,c.id AS call,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY c.__path,c.id ORDER BY n.__start)-1 AS position FROM calls c JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=c.__path AND n.parent=c.arguments_kind||':'||c.arguments_start||':'||c.arguments_end WHERE n.kind NOT IN ('comment','keyword_argument','list_splat','dictionary_splat')

stages.name: keywords
stages.query: SELECT c.__path,c.id AS call,k.id AS keyword,k.__start AS keyword_start,kn.text AS name,v.id AS value,v.__start,v.__end,v.text,v.kind FROM calls c JOIN nodes k ON k.__path=c.__path AND k.parent=c.arguments_kind||':'||c.arguments_start||':'||c.arguments_end AND k.kind='keyword_argument' JOIN nodes kn ON kn.__path=k.__path AND kn.id=k.name_kind||':'||k.name_start||':'||k.name_end JOIN nodes v ON v.__path=k.__path AND v.id=k.value_kind||':'||k.value_start||':'||k.value_end

stages.name: descendants
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE walk(__path,root,node) AS (SELECT __path,id,id FROM nodes UNION SELECT w.__path,w.root,e.dst FROM walk w JOIN edges e ON e.__path=w.__path AND e.src=w.node) SELECT * FROM walk

stages.name: returns
stages.query: SELECT n.*,v.id AS value,v.kind AS expr_kind,v.text AS expr_text,o.fn FROM nodes n JOIN nodes v ON v.__path=n.__path AND v.parent=n.id LEFT JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.id=n.id WHERE n.kind='return_statement'

stages.name: assignments
stages.query: SELECT n.*,l.id AS target,l.kind AS target_kind,l.text AS target_text,r.id AS value,r.kind AS expr_kind,r.text AS expr_text,o.fn FROM nodes n JOIN nodes l ON l.__path=n.__path AND l.id=n.left_kind||':'||n.left_start||':'||n.left_end LEFT JOIN nodes r ON r.__path=n.__path AND r.id=n.right_kind||':'||n.right_start||':'||n.right_end LEFT JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.id=n.id WHERE n.kind='assignment'

stages.name: step_classes
stages.query: SELECT c.* FROM classes c WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes args JOIN nodes b ON b.__path=args.__path AND b.parent=args.id WHERE args.__path=c.__path AND args.parent=c.id AND args.kind='argument_list' AND rx_matches(b.text,'^(?:[A-Za-z_]\w*\.)*ServerPlanStep(?:\[.*\])?$'))

stages.name: step_methods
stages.query: SELECT m.* FROM methods m JOIN step_classes c ON c.__path=m.__path AND c.id=m.cls

stages.name: first_methods
stages.query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT *,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY __path,cls,name ORDER BY __start) AS selected FROM step_methods) WHERE selected=1

stages.name: method_descendants
stages.query: SELECT m.__path,m.id AS method,m.cls,m.name,d.node FROM step_methods m JOIN descendants d ON d.__path=m.__path AND d.root=m.id

stages.name: method_returns
stages.query: SELECT m.__path,m.id AS method,m.cls,m.name,r.id,r.value,r.expr_kind,r.expr_text FROM first_methods m JOIN returns r ON r.__path=m.__path AND r.fn=m.id

stages.name: empty_tables
stages.query:
SELECT DISTINCT r.__path,r.method,r.cls,r.name FROM method_returns r JOIN calls c ON c.__path=r.__path AND c.id=r.value
 WHERE c.full_callee='frozenset' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords k WHERE k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id)
 AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arguments a WHERE a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id) OR
 ((SELECT count(*) FROM arguments a WHERE a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id)=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arguments a WHERE a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id AND a.kind IN ('list','tuple','set') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes v WHERE v.__path=a.__path AND v.parent=a.id))))

stages.name: roles
stages.query: SELECT DISTINCT __path,cls,CASE WHEN expr_kind='attribute' THEN rx_extract(expr_text,'^StepExecutionRole\.(VIRTUAL|SQL|APPLY|CONTROL)$',1) ELSE upper(trim(expr_text,char(34)||char(39))) END AS role FROM method_returns WHERE name='execution_role'

stages.name: levels
stages.query: SELECT __path,cls,CAST(text AS INTEGER) AS level FROM (SELECT m.__path,m.cls,n.text,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY m.__path,m.cls ORDER BY n.__start) AS selected FROM method_descendants m JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=m.__path AND n.id=m.node WHERE m.name='level' AND n.kind='integer' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM returns r WHERE r.__path=n.__path AND r.value=n.id)) WHERE selected=1

stages.name: nonempty_keywords
stages.query: SELECT * FROM keywords k WHERE NOT (k.kind='none' OR (k.kind IN ('string','concatenated_string') AND trim(k.text,char(34)||char(39))='') OR (k.kind IN ('list','tuple','set') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes n WHERE n.__path=k.__path AND n.parent=k.value)))

stages.name: compiled
stages.query:
SELECT c.*,NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords k WHERE k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id AND k.name='grammar' AND k.kind!='none') AS grammarless,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nonempty_keywords k WHERE k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id AND k.name IN ('runtime_ref_ids','source_refs')) AS refs,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nonempty_keywords k WHERE k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id AND k.name IN ('runtime_ref_ids','source_refs','auxiliary_ctes')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords k WHERE k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id AND k.name='grammar' AND k.kind!='none') AS sql_surface
 FROM calls c WHERE c.full_callee='CompiledStep'

stages.name: compile_surfaces
stages.query: SELECT DISTINCT m.__path,m.cls,m.id AS method FROM first_methods m JOIN descendants d ON d.__path=m.__path AND d.root=m.id JOIN compiled c ON c.__path=d.__path AND c.id=d.node AND c.sql_surface WHERE m.name='compile'

stages.name: zero_io
stages.query:
SELECT c.__path,c.id AS cls FROM step_classes c JOIN levels l ON l.__path=c.__path AND l.cls=c.id AND l.level=0
 JOIN empty_tables r ON r.__path=c.__path AND r.cls=c.id AND r.name='tables_read' JOIN empty_tables w ON w.__path=c.__path AND w.cls=c.id AND w.name='tables_written'
 JOIN first_methods m ON m.__path=c.__path AND m.cls=c.id AND m.name='compile'
 WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM descendants d JOIN compiled cs ON cs.__path=d.__path AND cs.id=d.node WHERE d.__path=m.__path AND d.root=m.id AND
 (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arguments a WHERE a.__path=cs.__path AND a.call=cs.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords k WHERE k.__path=cs.__path AND k.call=cs.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords k WHERE k.__path=cs.__path AND k.call=cs.id AND k.name IN ('pre_op','post_op','on_commit','on_rollback') AND k.kind!='none')))

stages.name: local_bindings
stages.query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT f.__path,f.id AS owner,a.target_text AS name,a.value,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY f.__path,f.id,a.target_text ORDER BY a.__start DESC) AS selected FROM functions f JOIN assignments a ON a.__path=f.__path AND a.__start>f.__start AND a.__end<=f.__end WHERE a.target_kind='identifier' AND a.value IS NOT NULL) WHERE selected=1

stages.name: resolved_attributes
stages.query: SELECT DISTINCT m.__path,m.cls,a.attr FROM step_methods m JOIN descendants d ON d.__path=m.__path AND d.root=m.id JOIN assignments b ON b.__path=d.__path AND b.id=d.node JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=b.__path AND a.id=b.target WHERE m.name!='__init__' AND a.object_text='self' AND substr(a.attr,1,1)='_'

stages.name: compile_aliases
stages.query: SELECT DISTINCT m.__path,m.id AS method,a.target_text AS name,p.attr FROM step_methods m JOIN assignments a ON a.__path=m.__path AND a.fn=m.id JOIN attributes p ON p.__path=a.__path AND p.id=a.value WHERE m.name='compile' AND a.target_kind='identifier' AND p.object_text='self' AND substr(p.attr,1,1)='_'

stages.name: column_derived
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE derived(__path,id) AS (
 SELECT __path,id FROM calls WHERE full_callee LIKE '%cte_output_columns'
 UNION SELECT c.__path,e.src FROM derived c JOIN edges e ON e.__path=c.__path AND e.dst=c.id
 UNION SELECT n.__path,n.id FROM derived c JOIN local_bindings b ON b.__path=c.__path AND b.value=c.id JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=b.__path AND o.fn=b.owner JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=o.__path AND n.id=o.id AND n.kind='identifier' AND n.text=b.name
 ) SELECT * FROM derived

stages.name: postop_symbols
stages.query:
SELECT DISTINCT post.__path,post.call,a.text AS symbol FROM keywords post JOIN descendants d ON d.__path=post.__path AND d.root=post.value JOIN calls b ON b.__path=d.__path AND b.id=d.node JOIN arguments arg ON arg.__path=b.__path AND arg.call=b.id JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=arg.__path AND a.id=arg.id WHERE post.name='closed_post_op' AND b.callee='runtime_builder_post_op' AND (arg.position=0 AND a.object_text='RuntimeBuilderKind' OR arg.position=1 AND a.object_text='RuntimeBuilderName')
 UNION SELECT DISTINCT post.__path,post.call,a.text FROM keywords post JOIN descendants d ON d.__path=post.__path AND d.root=post.value JOIN calls b ON b.__path=d.__path AND b.id=d.node JOIN keywords k ON k.__path=b.__path AND k.call=b.id JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=k.__path AND a.id=k.value WHERE post.name='closed_post_op' AND b.callee IN ('runtime_builder_post_op','RuntimeBuilderSpec') AND (k.name='kind' AND a.object_text='RuntimeBuilderKind' OR k.name='builder_name' AND a.object_text='RuntimeBuilderName')

stages.name: table_problems
stages.query:
SELECT * FROM (
 SELECT r.__path,r.cls,r.name,r.id,n.__start,n.__end,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY r.__path,r.cls,r.name ORDER BY n.__start) AS selected
 FROM method_returns r JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=r.__path AND n.id=r.id JOIN calls c ON c.__path=r.__path AND c.id=r.value JOIN arguments a ON a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id AND a.position=0
 WHERE r.name IN ('tables_read','tables_written') AND c.full_callee='frozenset' AND (a.kind NOT IN ('list','set','tuple') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes s WHERE s.__path=a.__path AND s.parent=a.id AND s.kind IN ('string','concatenated_string') AND trim(s.text,char(34)||char(39))!='*'))
 ) WHERE selected=1
 UNION SELECT m.__path,m.cls,m.name,m.id,m.__start,m.__end,1 FROM first_methods m WHERE m.name IN ('tables_read','tables_written') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM empty_tables e WHERE e.__path=m.__path AND e.method=m.id)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM method_returns r JOIN calls c ON c.__path=r.__path AND c.id=r.value JOIN arguments a ON a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id AND a.position=0 WHERE r.__path=m.__path AND r.method=m.id AND c.full_callee='frozenset' AND (a.kind NOT IN ('list','set','tuple') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes s WHERE s.__path=a.__path AND s.parent=a.id AND s.kind IN ('string','concatenated_string') AND trim(s.text,char(34)||char(39))!='*')))

stages.name: nodes
stages.query:
SELECT *,kind||':'||__start||':'||__end AS id,
 parent_kind||':'||parent_start||':'||parent_end AS parent,
 ancestor_kind||':'||ancestor_start||':'||ancestor_end AS edge_parent,
 row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY __path,parent_start,parent_end,parent_kind ORDER BY __start,__end,kind)-1 AS ordinal
 FROM raw_nodes

stages.name: edges
stages.query: SELECT __path,edge_parent AS src,id AS dst,ordinal FROM nodes WHERE edge_parent IS NOT NULL

stages.name: functions
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.name_source AS name FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='function_definition'

stages.name: ownership
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE owned(__path,id,fn,cls,top_fn) AS (
 SELECT n.__path,n.id,CASE WHEN n.kind='function_definition' THEN n.id END,CASE WHEN n.kind='class_definition' THEN n.id END,CASE WHEN n.kind='function_definition' THEN n.id END FROM nodes n
 LEFT JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=n.__path AND parent.id=n.edge_parent WHERE parent.id IS NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT child.__path,child.id,CASE WHEN child.kind='function_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.fn END,CASE WHEN child.kind='class_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.cls END,CASE WHEN owned.top_fn IS NULL AND child.kind='function_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.top_fn END
 FROM owned JOIN edges e ON e.__path=owned.__path AND e.src=owned.id
 JOIN nodes child ON child.__path=e.__path AND child.id=e.dst) SELECT * FROM owned

stages.name: classes
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.name_source AS name FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='class_definition'

stages.name: methods
stages.query:
SELECT f.*,c.id AS cls,c.name AS class_name FROM functions f JOIN classes c ON c.__path=f.__path
 WHERE f.parent=c.body_kind||':'||c.body_start||':'||c.body_end OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes d WHERE d.__path=f.__path AND d.id=f.parent AND d.kind='decorated_definition' AND d.parent=c.body_kind||':'||c.body_start||':'||c.body_end)

stages.name: attributes
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.attribute_source AS attr,n.object_kind||':'||n.object_start||':'||n.object_end AS object,n.object_source AS object_text FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='attribute'

stages.name: calls
stages.query: SELECT n.*,f.id AS callee_id,f.kind AS callee_kind,f.text AS full_callee,coalesce(a.attr,f.text) AS callee,a.object AS receiver FROM nodes n JOIN nodes f ON f.__path=n.__path AND f.id=n.function_kind||':'||n.function_start||':'||n.function_end LEFT JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=f.__path AND a.id=f.id WHERE n.kind='call'

stages.name: arguments
stages.query: SELECT n.*,c.id AS call,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY c.__path,c.id ORDER BY n.__start)-1 AS position FROM calls c JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=c.__path AND n.parent=c.arguments_kind||':'||c.arguments_start||':'||c.arguments_end WHERE n.kind NOT IN ('comment','keyword_argument','list_splat','dictionary_splat')

stages.name: keywords
stages.query: SELECT c.__path,c.id AS call,k.id AS keyword,k.__start AS keyword_start,kn.text AS name,v.id AS value,v.__start,v.__end,v.text,v.kind FROM calls c JOIN nodes k ON k.__path=c.__path AND k.parent=c.arguments_kind||':'||c.arguments_start||':'||c.arguments_end AND k.kind='keyword_argument' JOIN nodes kn ON kn.__path=k.__path AND kn.id=k.name_kind||':'||k.name_start||':'||k.name_end JOIN nodes v ON v.__path=k.__path AND v.id=k.value_kind||':'||k.value_start||':'||k.value_end

stages.name: descendants
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE walk(__path,root,node) AS (SELECT __path,id,id FROM nodes UNION SELECT w.__path,w.root,e.dst FROM walk w JOIN edges e ON e.__path=w.__path AND e.src=w.node) SELECT * FROM walk

stages.name: assignments
stages.query: SELECT n.*,l.id AS target,l.kind AS target_kind,l.text AS target_text,r.id AS value,r.kind AS expr_kind,r.text AS expr_text,o.fn FROM nodes n JOIN nodes l ON l.__path=n.__path AND l.id=n.left_kind||':'||n.left_start||':'||n.left_end LEFT JOIN nodes r ON r.__path=n.__path AND r.id=n.right_kind||':'||n.right_start||':'||n.right_end LEFT JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.id=n.id WHERE n.kind='assignment'

stages.name: parameters
stages.query:
SELECT f.__path,f.id AS fn,p.id,p.kind,p.text,n.text AS name,p.type_kind||':'||p.type_start||':'||p.type_end AS annotation,
 row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY f.__path,f.id ORDER BY p.__start)-1 AS position FROM functions f JOIN nodes p ON p.__path=f.__path AND p.parent=f.parameters_kind||':'||f.parameters_start||':'||f.parameters_end JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=p.__path AND (n.id=p.id AND p.kind='identifier' OR n.parent=p.id AND n.ordinal=0 AND n.kind='identifier')
 WHERE p.kind IN ('identifier','typed_parameter','default_parameter','typed_default_parameter')

stages.name: step_classes
stages.query: SELECT c.* FROM classes c WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes args JOIN nodes b ON b.__path=args.__path AND b.parent=args.id WHERE args.__path=c.__path AND args.parent=c.id AND args.kind='argument_list' AND rx_matches(b.text,'^(?:[A-Za-z_]\w*\.)*ServerPlanStep(?:\[.*\])?$'))

stages.name: step_methods
stages.query: SELECT m.* FROM methods m JOIN step_classes c ON c.__path=m.__path AND c.id=m.cls

stages.name: nonempty_keywords
stages.query: SELECT * FROM keywords k WHERE NOT (k.kind='none' OR (k.kind IN ('string','concatenated_string') AND trim(k.text,char(34)||char(39))='') OR (k.kind IN ('list','tuple','set') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes n WHERE n.__path=k.__path AND n.parent=k.value)))

stages.name: compiled
stages.query:
SELECT c.*,NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords k WHERE k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id AND k.name='grammar' AND k.kind!='none') AS grammarless,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nonempty_keywords k WHERE k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id AND k.name IN ('runtime_ref_ids','source_refs')) AS refs,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nonempty_keywords k WHERE k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id AND k.name IN ('runtime_ref_ids','source_refs','auxiliary_ctes')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords k WHERE k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id AND k.name='grammar' AND k.kind!='none') AS sql_surface
 FROM calls c WHERE c.full_callee='CompiledStep'

stages.name: compile_aliases
stages.query: SELECT DISTINCT m.__path,m.id AS method,a.target_text AS name,p.attr FROM step_methods m JOIN assignments a ON a.__path=m.__path AND a.fn=m.id JOIN attributes p ON p.__path=a.__path AND p.id=a.value WHERE m.name='compile' AND a.target_kind='identifier' AND p.object_text='self' AND substr(p.attr,1,1)='_'

stages.name: callback_links
stages.query:
SELECT m.__path,m.id AS method,m.cls,c.id AS call,k.keyword,k.name AS kind,f.id AS callback,f.name AS callback_name FROM step_methods m JOIN compiled c ON c.__path=m.__path AND c.__start>m.__start AND c.__end<=m.__end
 JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=c.__path AND o.id=c.id AND o.fn=m.id JOIN keywords k ON k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id AND k.name IN ('post_op','post_op_with_refs','on_commit','on_rollback') AND k.kind='identifier'
 JOIN functions f ON f.__path=k.__path AND f.name=k.text AND f.__start>m.__start AND f.__end<=m.__end
 WHERE m.name='compile' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM functions newer WHERE newer.__path=f.__path AND newer.name=f.name AND newer.__start>f.__start AND newer.__end<=m.__end)

stages.name: authority_parameters
stages.query: SELECT p.* FROM parameters p JOIN descendants d ON d.__path=p.__path AND d.root=p.annotation JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=d.__path AND n.id=d.node WHERE n.kind='identifier' AND n.text IN ('DatabaseConnection','ReadTransaction','SqlConnection','SyncDatabaseConnection','SyncSqlConnection','WriteTransaction')

stages.name: authority_returns
stages.query: SELECT DISTINCT f.__path,f.name FROM functions f JOIN descendants d ON d.__path=f.__path AND d.root=f.return_type_kind||':'||f.return_type_start||':'||f.return_type_end JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=d.__path AND n.id=d.node WHERE n.kind='identifier' AND n.text IN ('DatabaseConnection','ReadTransaction','SqlConnection','SyncDatabaseConnection','SyncSqlConnection','WriteTransaction')

stages.name: callback_carriers
stages.query: SELECT DISTINCT l.__path,l.keyword,p.name FROM callback_links l JOIN parameters p ON p.__path=l.__path AND p.fn=l.callback WHERE (l.kind IN ('post_op','post_op_with_refs') AND p.position=1) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM descendants d JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=d.__path AND n.id=d.node WHERE d.__path=p.__path AND d.root=p.annotation AND n.kind='identifier' AND n.text='Hydrator')

stages.name: bad_callback_nodes
stages.query:
SELECT l.__path,l.keyword,n.id,n.__start,n.__end FROM callback_links l JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=l.__path JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.id=n.id AND o.fn=l.callback
 WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM attributes a JOIN callback_carriers p ON p.__path=a.__path AND p.keyword=l.keyword AND p.name=a.object_text WHERE a.__path=n.__path AND a.id=n.id AND a.attr IN ('_conn','_serverplan_runtime_txn','_serverplan_sql_conn','_txn','conn','sql_conn','txn')) OR EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM calls c WHERE c.__path=n.__path AND c.id=n.id AND (
 c.callee_kind='identifier' AND (c.callee IN ('active_pipeline_txn_for_callbacks') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM authority_returns f WHERE f.__path=c.__path AND f.name=c.callee))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arguments a JOIN authority_parameters p ON p.__path=a.__path AND p.fn=l.callback AND p.name=a.text WHERE a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id AND a.kind='identifier')
 OR c.full_callee='getattr' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arguments a JOIN callback_carriers p ON p.__path=a.__path AND p.keyword=l.keyword AND p.name=a.text WHERE a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id AND a.position=0 AND a.kind='identifier') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arguments a WHERE a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id AND a.position=1 AND trim(a.text,char(34)||char(39)) IN ('_conn','_serverplan_runtime_txn','_serverplan_sql_conn','_txn','conn','sql_conn','txn'))))

stages.name: postop_callbacks
stages.query: SELECT m.__path,m.id AS method,m.cls,f.id AS callback FROM step_methods m JOIN functions f ON f.__path=m.__path AND f.__start>m.__start AND f.__end<=m.__end WHERE m.name='compile' AND f.name NOT IN ('on_commit','on_rollback')

stages.name: nodes
stages.query:
SELECT *,kind||':'||__start||':'||__end AS id,
 parent_kind||':'||parent_start||':'||parent_end AS parent,
 ancestor_kind||':'||ancestor_start||':'||ancestor_end AS edge_parent,
 row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY __path,parent_start,parent_end,parent_kind ORDER BY __start,__end,kind)-1 AS ordinal
 FROM raw_nodes

stages.name: edges
stages.query: SELECT __path,edge_parent AS src,id AS dst,ordinal FROM nodes WHERE edge_parent IS NOT NULL

stages.name: fields
stages.query: SELECT __path,id AS owner,'value' AS role,value_kind||':'||value_start||':'||value_end AS child FROM nodes WHERE value_start IS NOT NULL

stages.name: functions
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.name_source AS name FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='function_definition'

stages.name: classes
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.name_source AS name FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='class_definition'

stages.name: methods
stages.query:
SELECT f.*,c.id AS cls,c.name AS class_name FROM functions f JOIN classes c ON c.__path=f.__path
 WHERE f.parent=c.body_kind||':'||c.body_start||':'||c.body_end OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes d WHERE d.__path=f.__path AND d.id=f.parent AND d.kind='decorated_definition' AND d.parent=c.body_kind||':'||c.body_start||':'||c.body_end)

stages.name: attributes
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.attribute_source AS attr,n.object_kind||':'||n.object_start||':'||n.object_end AS object,n.object_source AS object_text FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='attribute'

stages.name: calls
stages.query: SELECT n.*,f.id AS callee_id,f.kind AS callee_kind,f.text AS full_callee,coalesce(a.attr,f.text) AS callee,a.object AS receiver FROM nodes n JOIN nodes f ON f.__path=n.__path AND f.id=n.function_kind||':'||n.function_start||':'||n.function_end LEFT JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=f.__path AND a.id=f.id WHERE n.kind='call'

stages.name: arguments
stages.query: SELECT n.*,c.id AS call,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY c.__path,c.id ORDER BY n.__start)-1 AS position FROM calls c JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=c.__path AND n.parent=c.arguments_kind||':'||c.arguments_start||':'||c.arguments_end WHERE n.kind NOT IN ('comment','keyword_argument','list_splat','dictionary_splat')

stages.name: keywords
stages.query: SELECT c.__path,c.id AS call,k.id AS keyword,k.__start AS keyword_start,kn.text AS name,v.id AS value,v.__start,v.__end,v.text,v.kind FROM calls c JOIN nodes k ON k.__path=c.__path AND k.parent=c.arguments_kind||':'||c.arguments_start||':'||c.arguments_end AND k.kind='keyword_argument' JOIN nodes kn ON kn.__path=k.__path AND kn.id=k.name_kind||':'||k.name_start||':'||k.name_end JOIN nodes v ON v.__path=k.__path AND v.id=k.value_kind||':'||k.value_start||':'||k.value_end

stages.name: descendants
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE walk(__path,root,node) AS (SELECT __path,id,id FROM nodes UNION SELECT w.__path,w.root,e.dst FROM walk w JOIN edges e ON e.__path=w.__path AND e.src=w.node) SELECT * FROM walk

stages.name: parameters
stages.query:
SELECT f.__path,f.id AS fn,p.id,p.kind,p.text,n.text AS name,p.type_kind||':'||p.type_start||':'||p.type_end AS annotation,
 row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY f.__path,f.id ORDER BY p.__start)-1 AS position FROM functions f JOIN nodes p ON p.__path=f.__path AND p.parent=f.parameters_kind||':'||f.parameters_start||':'||f.parameters_end JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=p.__path AND (n.id=p.id AND p.kind='identifier' OR n.parent=p.id AND n.ordinal=0 AND n.kind='identifier')
 WHERE p.kind IN ('identifier','typed_parameter','default_parameter','typed_default_parameter')

stages.name: raw_parameters
stages.query: SELECT DISTINCT p.__path,p.fn,p.name FROM parameters p WHERE p.name IN ('raw','raw_rows','rows') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM descendants d JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=d.__path AND n.id=d.node WHERE d.__path=p.__path AND d.root=p.annotation AND ((n.kind='identifier' AND n.text='RawResult') OR (n.kind IN ('string','concatenated_string') AND instr(n.text,'RawResult')>0)))

stages.name: raw_shapers
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE shaping(__path,name) AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT f.__path,f.name FROM functions f JOIN raw_parameters p ON p.__path=f.__path AND p.fn=f.id JOIN descendants d ON d.__path=f.__path AND d.root=f.id JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=d.__path AND n.id=d.node
 WHERE (n.kind IN ('for_statement','for_in_clause') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM descendants it JOIN nodes r ON r.__path=it.__path AND r.id=it.node WHERE it.__path=n.__path AND it.root=n.right_kind||':'||n.right_start||':'||n.right_end AND r.kind='identifier' AND r.text=p.name))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM calls c JOIN arguments a ON a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id AND a.position=0 JOIN descendants v ON v.__path=a.__path AND v.root=a.id JOIN nodes r ON r.__path=v.__path AND r.id=v.node WHERE c.__path=n.__path AND c.id=n.id AND c.full_callee IN ('list','tuple','dict','set','sorted') AND r.kind='identifier' AND r.text=p.name)
 UNION SELECT f.__path,f.name FROM functions f JOIN raw_parameters p ON p.__path=f.__path AND p.fn=f.id JOIN descendants d ON d.__path=f.__path AND d.root=f.id JOIN calls c ON c.__path=d.__path AND c.id=d.node JOIN shaping s ON s.__path=c.__path AND s.name=c.full_callee
 ) SELECT * FROM shaping

stages.name: shaping_methods
stages.query: SELECT DISTINCT m.__path,m.cls,m.id FROM methods m WHERE m.name='materialize' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM raw_shapers s WHERE s.__path=m.__path AND s.name=m.name) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM descendants d JOIN calls c ON c.__path=d.__path AND c.id=d.node JOIN raw_shapers s ON s.__path=c.__path AND s.name=c.full_callee WHERE d.__path=m.__path AND d.root=m.id))

stages.name: materializer_values
stages.query: SELECT n.__path,n.id,c.id AS cls FROM nodes n JOIN classes c ON c.__path=n.__path WHERE n.kind='identifier' AND n.text=c.name OR n.kind='call' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM calls call WHERE call.__path=n.__path AND call.id=n.id AND call.callee=c.name)

stages.name: payload_roots
stages.query: SELECT k.* FROM keywords k JOIN calls c ON c.__path=k.__path AND c.id=k.call WHERE c.callee='ResultMaterializationSpec' AND (k.name='literal_payload' OR k.name='terminal_literal' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords other WHERE other.__path=k.__path AND other.call=k.call AND other.name='literal_payload'))

stages.name: payload_values
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE values_in_payload(__path,root,id) AS (
 SELECT __path,value,value FROM payload_roots
 UNION SELECT v.__path,v.root,e.dst FROM values_in_payload v JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=v.__path AND n.id=v.id JOIN edges e ON e.__path=n.__path AND e.src=n.id WHERE n.kind IN ('tuple','list','set','dictionary','argument_list','keyword_argument')
 UNION SELECT v.__path,v.root,k.value FROM values_in_payload v JOIN calls c ON c.__path=v.__path AND c.id=v.id JOIN keywords k ON k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id
 UNION SELECT v.__path,v.root,a.id FROM values_in_payload v JOIN calls c ON c.__path=v.__path AND c.id=v.id JOIN arguments a ON a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id
 UNION SELECT v.__path,v.root,f.child FROM values_in_payload v JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=v.__path AND n.id=v.id AND n.kind='pair' JOIN fields f ON f.__path=n.__path AND f.owner=n.id AND f.role='value'

stages.name: nodes
stages.query:
SELECT *,kind||':'||__start||':'||__end AS id,
 parent_kind||':'||parent_start||':'||parent_end AS parent,
 ancestor_kind||':'||ancestor_start||':'||ancestor_end AS edge_parent,
 row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY __path,parent_start,parent_end,parent_kind ORDER BY __start,__end,kind)-1 AS ordinal
 FROM raw_nodes

stages.name: edges
stages.query: SELECT __path,edge_parent AS src,id AS dst,ordinal FROM nodes WHERE edge_parent IS NOT NULL

stages.name: functions
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.name_source AS name FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='function_definition'

stages.name: ownership
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE owned(__path,id,fn,cls,top_fn) AS (
 SELECT n.__path,n.id,CASE WHEN n.kind='function_definition' THEN n.id END,CASE WHEN n.kind='class_definition' THEN n.id END,CASE WHEN n.kind='function_definition' THEN n.id END FROM nodes n
 LEFT JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=n.__path AND parent.id=n.edge_parent WHERE parent.id IS NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT child.__path,child.id,CASE WHEN child.kind='function_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.fn END,CASE WHEN child.kind='class_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.cls END,CASE WHEN owned.top_fn IS NULL AND child.kind='function_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.top_fn END
 FROM owned JOIN edges e ON e.__path=owned.__path AND e.src=owned.id
 JOIN nodes child ON child.__path=e.__path AND child.id=e.dst) SELECT * FROM owned

stages.name: classes
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.name_source AS name FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='class_definition'

stages.name: attributes
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.attribute_source AS attr,n.object_kind||':'||n.object_start||':'||n.object_end AS object,n.object_source AS object_text FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='attribute'

stages.name: calls
stages.query: SELECT n.*,f.id AS callee_id,f.kind AS callee_kind,f.text AS full_callee,coalesce(a.attr,f.text) AS callee,a.object AS receiver FROM nodes n JOIN nodes f ON f.__path=n.__path AND f.id=n.function_kind||':'||n.function_start||':'||n.function_end LEFT JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=f.__path AND a.id=f.id WHERE n.kind='call'

stages.name: arguments
stages.query: SELECT n.*,c.id AS call,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY c.__path,c.id ORDER BY n.__start)-1 AS position FROM calls c JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=c.__path AND n.parent=c.arguments_kind||':'||c.arguments_start||':'||c.arguments_end WHERE n.kind NOT IN ('comment','keyword_argument','list_splat','dictionary_splat')

stages.name: keywords
stages.query: SELECT c.__path,c.id AS call,k.id AS keyword,k.__start AS keyword_start,kn.text AS name,v.id AS value,v.__start,v.__end,v.text,v.kind FROM calls c JOIN nodes k ON k.__path=c.__path AND k.parent=c.arguments_kind||':'||c.arguments_start||':'||c.arguments_end AND k.kind='keyword_argument' JOIN nodes kn ON kn.__path=k.__path AND kn.id=k.name_kind||':'||k.name_start||':'||k.name_end JOIN nodes v ON v.__path=k.__path AND v.id=k.value_kind||':'||k.value_start||':'||k.value_end

stages.name: returns
stages.query: SELECT n.*,v.id AS value,v.kind AS expr_kind,v.text AS expr_text,o.fn FROM nodes n JOIN nodes v ON v.__path=n.__path AND v.parent=n.id LEFT JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.id=n.id WHERE n.kind='return_statement'

stages.name: assignments
stages.query: SELECT n.*,l.id AS target,l.kind AS target_kind,l.text AS target_text,r.id AS value,r.kind AS expr_kind,r.text AS expr_text,o.fn FROM nodes n JOIN nodes l ON l.__path=n.__path AND l.id=n.left_kind||':'||n.left_start||':'||n.left_end LEFT JOIN nodes r ON r.__path=n.__path AND r.id=n.right_kind||':'||n.right_start||':'||n.right_end LEFT JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.id=n.id WHERE n.kind='assignment'

stages.name: local_bindings
stages.query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT f.__path,f.id AS owner,a.target_text AS name,a.value,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY f.__path,f.id,a.target_text ORDER BY a.__start DESC) AS selected FROM functions f JOIN assignments a ON a.__path=f.__path AND a.__start>f.__start AND a.__end<=f.__end WHERE a.target_kind='identifier' AND a.value IS NOT NULL) WHERE selected=1

stages.name: expression_edges
stages.query:
SELECT p.__path,c.id AS src,p.id AS dst FROM nodes p JOIN nodes c ON c.__path=p.__path AND c.parent=p.id WHERE p.kind IN ('tuple','list','set','expression_list','parenthesized_expression','keyword_argument','argument_list')
 UNION SELECT p.__path,c.id,p.id FROM nodes p JOIN nodes c ON c.__path=p.__path AND c.parent=p.id AND c.ordinal=1 WHERE p.kind='pair'
 UNION SELECT p.__path,c.id,p.id FROM nodes p JOIN nodes c ON c.__path=p.__path AND c.parent=p.id WHERE p.kind='dictionary'
 UNION SELECT c.__path,a.id,c.id FROM calls c JOIN arguments a ON a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id
 UNION SELECT c.__path,k.value,c.id FROM calls c JOIN keywords k ON k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id
 UNION SELECT n.__path,b.value,n.id FROM nodes n JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.id=n.id JOIN local_bindings b ON b.__path=n.__path AND b.owner=o.fn AND b.name=n.text WHERE n.kind='identifier'
 UNION SELECT c.__path,r.value,c.id FROM calls c JOIN functions f ON f.__path=c.__path AND f.name=c.full_callee JOIN returns r ON r.__path=f.__path AND r.fn=f.id

stages.name: callable_edges
stages.query:
SELECT a.__path,a.object AS src,a.id AS dst FROM attributes a
 UNION SELECT a.__path,a.attribute_kind||':'||a.attribute_start||':'||a.attribute_end,a.id FROM attributes a
 UNION SELECT c.__path,c.callee_id,c.id FROM calls c
 UNION SELECT c.__path,a.id,c.id FROM calls c JOIN arguments a ON a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id
 UNION SELECT c.__path,k.value,c.id FROM calls c JOIN keywords k ON k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id
 UNION SELECT n.__path,c.id,n.id FROM nodes n JOIN nodes c ON c.__path=n.__path AND c.parent=n.id AND c.ordinal=0 WHERE n.kind IN ('subscript','parenthesized_expression')

stages.name: user_callable
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE shaped(__path,id) AS (SELECT __path,id FROM nodes WHERE kind='lambda' OR kind='identifier' AND rx_matches(lower(text),'callable|callback|decoder|fn|function|hook|mapper|picker|processor|projector|row_decoder|transform') UNION SELECT s.__path,e.dst FROM shaped s JOIN callable_edges e ON e.__path=s.__path AND e.src=s.id) SELECT * FROM shaped

stages.name: direct_callable
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE direct(__path,id) AS (
 SELECT n.__path,n.id FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='lambda' OR n.kind='identifier' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM functions f WHERE f.__path=n.__path AND f.name=n.text) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assignments a WHERE a.__path=n.__path AND a.target_text=n.text AND a.expr_kind='lambda'))
 UNION SELECT __path,id FROM calls WHERE full_callee IN ('partial','functools.partial')
 UNION SELECT s.__path,e.dst FROM direct s JOIN expression_edges e ON e.__path=s.__path AND e.src=s.id JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=e.__path AND n.id=e.dst WHERE n.kind!='identifier') SELECT * FROM direct

stages.name: mutable_values
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE mutable(__path,id) AS (SELECT __path,id FROM nodes WHERE kind IN ('list','dictionary','set','list_comprehension','dictionary_comprehension','set_comprehension') UNION SELECT m.__path,n.parent FROM mutable m JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=m.__path AND n.id=m.id JOIN nodes p ON p.__path=n.__path AND p.id=n.parent AND p.kind='tuple') SELECT * FROM mutable

stages.name: builder_calls
stages.query: SELECT * FROM calls WHERE callee IN ('RuntimeBuilderSpec','runtime_builder_post_op','runtime_op_post_op')

stages.name: literal_kwargs
stages.query: SELECT k.* FROM keywords k JOIN builder_calls c ON c.__path=k.__path AND c.id=k.call AND c.callee='RuntimeBuilderSpec' WHERE k.name='literal_kwargs'

stages.name: literal_pairs
stages.query: SELECT k.__path,k.value AS root,key.text AS key,value.id AS value FROM literal_kwargs k JOIN nodes pair ON pair.__path=k.__path AND pair.parent=k.value JOIN nodes key ON key.__path=pair.__path AND key.parent=pair.id AND key.ordinal=0 JOIN nodes value ON value.__path=pair.__path AND value.parent=pair.id AND value.ordinal=1 WHERE pair.kind IN ('pair','tuple','list') AND key.kind IN ('string','concatenated_string')

stages.name: nodes
stages.query:
SELECT *,kind||':'||__start||':'||__end AS id,
 parent_kind||':'||parent_start||':'||parent_end AS parent,
 ancestor_kind||':'||ancestor_start||':'||ancestor_end AS edge_parent,
 row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY __path,parent_start,parent_end,parent_kind ORDER BY __start,__end,kind)-1 AS ordinal
 FROM raw_nodes

stages.name: edges
stages.query: SELECT __path,edge_parent AS src,id AS dst,ordinal FROM nodes WHERE edge_parent IS NOT NULL

stages.name: functions
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.name_source AS name FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='function_definition'

stages.name: ownership
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE owned(__path,id,fn,cls,top_fn) AS (
 SELECT n.__path,n.id,CASE WHEN n.kind='function_definition' THEN n.id END,CASE WHEN n.kind='class_definition' THEN n.id END,CASE WHEN n.kind='function_definition' THEN n.id END FROM nodes n
 LEFT JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=n.__path AND parent.id=n.edge_parent WHERE parent.id IS NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT child.__path,child.id,CASE WHEN child.kind='function_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.fn END,CASE WHEN child.kind='class_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.cls END,CASE WHEN owned.top_fn IS NULL AND child.kind='function_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.top_fn END
 FROM owned JOIN edges e ON e.__path=owned.__path AND e.src=owned.id
 JOIN nodes child ON child.__path=e.__path AND child.id=e.dst) SELECT * FROM owned

stages.name: attributes
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.attribute_source AS attr,n.object_kind||':'||n.object_start||':'||n.object_end AS object,n.object_source AS object_text FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='attribute'

stages.name: calls
stages.query: SELECT n.*,f.id AS callee_id,f.kind AS callee_kind,f.text AS full_callee,coalesce(a.attr,f.text) AS callee,a.object AS receiver FROM nodes n JOIN nodes f ON f.__path=n.__path AND f.id=n.function_kind||':'||n.function_start||':'||n.function_end LEFT JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=f.__path AND a.id=f.id WHERE n.kind='call'

stages.name: arguments
stages.query: SELECT n.*,c.id AS call,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY c.__path,c.id ORDER BY n.__start)-1 AS position FROM calls c JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=c.__path AND n.parent=c.arguments_kind||':'||c.arguments_start||':'||c.arguments_end WHERE n.kind NOT IN ('comment','keyword_argument','list_splat','dictionary_splat')

stages.name: keywords
stages.query: SELECT c.__path,c.id AS call,k.id AS keyword,k.__start AS keyword_start,kn.text AS name,v.id AS value,v.__start,v.__end,v.text,v.kind FROM calls c JOIN nodes k ON k.__path=c.__path AND k.parent=c.arguments_kind||':'||c.arguments_start||':'||c.arguments_end AND k.kind='keyword_argument' JOIN nodes kn ON kn.__path=k.__path AND kn.id=k.name_kind||':'||k.name_start||':'||k.name_end JOIN nodes v ON v.__path=k.__path AND v.id=k.value_kind||':'||k.value_start||':'||k.value_end

stages.name: descendants
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE walk(__path,root,node) AS (SELECT __path,id,id FROM nodes UNION SELECT w.__path,w.root,e.dst FROM walk w JOIN edges e ON e.__path=w.__path AND e.src=w.node) SELECT * FROM walk

stages.name: returns
stages.query: SELECT n.*,v.id AS value,v.kind AS expr_kind,v.text AS expr_text,o.fn FROM nodes n JOIN nodes v ON v.__path=n.__path AND v.parent=n.id LEFT JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.id=n.id WHERE n.kind='return_statement'

stages.name: parameters
stages.query:
SELECT f.__path,f.id AS fn,p.id,p.kind,p.text,n.text AS name,p.type_kind||':'||p.type_start||':'||p.type_end AS annotation,
 row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY f.__path,f.id ORDER BY p.__start)-1 AS position FROM functions f JOIN nodes p ON p.__path=f.__path AND p.parent=f.parameters_kind||':'||f.parameters_start||':'||f.parameters_end JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=p.__path AND (n.id=p.id AND p.kind='identifier' OR n.parent=p.id AND n.ordinal=0 AND n.kind='identifier')
 WHERE p.kind IN ('identifier','typed_parameter','default_parameter','typed_default_parameter')

stages.name: nonempty_keywords
stages.query: SELECT * FROM keywords k WHERE NOT (k.kind='none' OR (k.kind IN ('string','concatenated_string') AND trim(k.text,char(34)||char(39))='') OR (k.kind IN ('list','tuple','set') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes n WHERE n.__path=k.__path AND n.parent=k.value)))

stages.name: compiled
stages.query:
SELECT c.*,NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords k WHERE k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id AND k.name='grammar' AND k.kind!='none') AS grammarless,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nonempty_keywords k WHERE k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id AND k.name IN ('runtime_ref_ids','source_refs')) AS refs,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nonempty_keywords k WHERE k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id AND k.name IN ('runtime_ref_ids','source_refs','auxiliary_ctes')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords k WHERE k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id AND k.name='grammar' AND k.kind!='none') AS sql_surface
 FROM calls c WHERE c.full_callee='CompiledStep'

stages.name: static_exception_seeds
stages.query:
SELECT c.__path,c.id FROM calls c JOIN arguments a ON a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id AND a.position=0 WHERE c.full_callee LIKE '%static_exception_post_op' AND a.text IN ('RuntimeError','TypeError','NotImplementedError')
 UNION SELECT c.__path,c.id FROM calls c JOIN arguments a ON a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id AND a.position=0 JOIN calls spec ON spec.__path=a.__path AND spec.id=a.id WHERE c.full_callee LIKE '%CompiledPostOp.assert_result' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords k WHERE k.__path=spec.__path AND k.call=spec.id AND k.name='static_exception' AND k.kind IN ('identifier','attribute') AND k.text NOT IN ('RuntimeError','TypeError','NotImplementedError'))
 UNION SELECT c.__path,c.id FROM calls c JOIN keywords a ON a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id AND a.name='spec' JOIN calls spec ON spec.__path=a.__path AND spec.id=a.value WHERE c.full_callee LIKE '%CompiledPostOp.assert_result' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arguments pos WHERE pos.__path=c.__path AND pos.call=c.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords k WHERE k.__path=spec.__path AND k.call=spec.id AND k.name='static_exception' AND k.kind IN ('identifier','attribute') AND k.text NOT IN ('RuntimeError','TypeError','NotImplementedError'))

stages.name: static_exception_functions
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE bad(__path,name) AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT f.__path,f.name FROM functions f JOIN descendants d ON d.__path=f.__path AND d.root=f.id JOIN calls c ON c.__path=d.__path AND c.id=d.node AND c.callee='ResultAssertionSpec' JOIN keywords k ON k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id AND k.name='static_exception' AND k.kind='identifier' JOIN parameters p ON p.__path=f.__path AND p.fn=f.id AND p.name=k.text
 UNION SELECT f.__path,f.name FROM functions f JOIN returns r ON r.__path=f.__path AND r.fn=f.id JOIN static_exception_seeds b ON b.__path=r.__path AND b.id=r.value
 UNION SELECT f.__path,f.name FROM functions f JOIN returns r ON r.__path=f.__path AND r.fn=f.id JOIN calls c ON c.__path=r.__path AND c.id=r.value JOIN bad b ON b.__path=c.__path AND b.name=c.callee) SELECT * FROM bad

stages.name: materialization_functions
stages.query: SELECT DISTINCT f.__path,f.id FROM functions f JOIN descendants d ON d.__path=f.__path AND d.root=f.id JOIN calls c ON c.__path=d.__path AND c.id=d.node WHERE c.callee='ResultMaterializationSpec' OR c.full_callee LIKE '%CompiledPostOp.materialize' OR c.callee='CompiledStep' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords k WHERE k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id AND k.name IN ('post_op','closed_post_op','post_op_with_refs'))

stages.name: nodes
stages.query:
SELECT *,kind||':'||__start||':'||__end AS id,
 parent_kind||':'||parent_start||':'||parent_end AS parent,
 ancestor_kind||':'||ancestor_start||':'||ancestor_end AS edge_parent,
 row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY __path,parent_start,parent_end,parent_kind ORDER BY __start,__end,kind)-1 AS ordinal
 FROM raw_nodes

stages.name: edges
stages.query: SELECT __path,edge_parent AS src,id AS dst,ordinal FROM nodes WHERE edge_parent IS NOT NULL

stages.name: functions
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.name_source AS name FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='function_definition'

stages.name: ownership
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE owned(__path,id,fn,cls,top_fn) AS (
 SELECT n.__path,n.id,CASE WHEN n.kind='function_definition' THEN n.id END,CASE WHEN n.kind='class_definition' THEN n.id END,CASE WHEN n.kind='function_definition' THEN n.id END FROM nodes n
 LEFT JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=n.__path AND parent.id=n.edge_parent WHERE parent.id IS NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT child.__path,child.id,CASE WHEN child.kind='function_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.fn END,CASE WHEN child.kind='class_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.cls END,CASE WHEN owned.top_fn IS NULL AND child.kind='function_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.top_fn END
 FROM owned JOIN edges e ON e.__path=owned.__path AND e.src=owned.id
 JOIN nodes child ON child.__path=e.__path AND child.id=e.dst) SELECT * FROM owned

stages.name: attributes
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.attribute_source AS attr,n.object_kind||':'||n.object_start||':'||n.object_end AS object,n.object_source AS object_text FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='attribute'

stages.name: calls
stages.query: SELECT n.*,f.id AS callee_id,f.kind AS callee_kind,f.text AS full_callee,coalesce(a.attr,f.text) AS callee,a.object AS receiver FROM nodes n JOIN nodes f ON f.__path=n.__path AND f.id=n.function_kind||':'||n.function_start||':'||n.function_end LEFT JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=f.__path AND a.id=f.id WHERE n.kind='call'

stages.name: arguments
stages.query: SELECT n.*,c.id AS call,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY c.__path,c.id ORDER BY n.__start)-1 AS position FROM calls c JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=c.__path AND n.parent=c.arguments_kind||':'||c.arguments_start||':'||c.arguments_end WHERE n.kind NOT IN ('comment','keyword_argument','list_splat','dictionary_splat')

stages.name: keywords
stages.query: SELECT c.__path,c.id AS call,k.id AS keyword,k.__start AS keyword_start,kn.text AS name,v.id AS value,v.__start,v.__end,v.text,v.kind FROM calls c JOIN nodes k ON k.__path=c.__path AND k.parent=c.arguments_kind||':'||c.arguments_start||':'||c.arguments_end AND k.kind='keyword_argument' JOIN nodes kn ON kn.__path=k.__path AND kn.id=k.name_kind||':'||k.name_start||':'||k.name_end JOIN nodes v ON v.__path=k.__path AND v.id=k.value_kind||':'||k.value_start||':'||k.value_end

stages.name: descendants
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE walk(__path,root,node) AS (SELECT __path,id,id FROM nodes UNION SELECT w.__path,w.root,e.dst FROM walk w JOIN edges e ON e.__path=w.__path AND e.src=w.node) SELECT * FROM walk

stages.name: assignments
stages.query: SELECT n.*,l.id AS target,l.kind AS target_kind,l.text AS target_text,r.id AS value,r.kind AS expr_kind,r.text AS expr_text,o.fn FROM nodes n JOIN nodes l ON l.__path=n.__path AND l.id=n.left_kind||':'||n.left_start||':'||n.left_end LEFT JOIN nodes r ON r.__path=n.__path AND r.id=n.right_kind||':'||n.right_start||':'||n.right_end LEFT JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.id=n.id WHERE n.kind='assignment'

stages.name: nonempty_keywords
stages.query: SELECT * FROM keywords k WHERE NOT (k.kind='none' OR (k.kind IN ('string','concatenated_string') AND trim(k.text,char(34)||char(39))='') OR (k.kind IN ('list','tuple','set') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes n WHERE n.__path=k.__path AND n.parent=k.value)))

stages.name: compiled
stages.query:
SELECT c.*,NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords k WHERE k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id AND k.name='grammar' AND k.kind!='none') AS grammarless,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nonempty_keywords k WHERE k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id AND k.name IN ('runtime_ref_ids','source_refs')) AS refs,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nonempty_keywords k WHERE k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id AND k.name IN ('runtime_ref_ids','source_refs','auxiliary_ctes')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords k WHERE k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id AND k.name='grammar' AND k.kind!='none') AS sql_surface
 FROM calls c WHERE c.full_callee='CompiledStep'

stages.name: callable_edges
stages.query:
SELECT a.__path,a.object AS src,a.id AS dst FROM attributes a
 UNION SELECT a.__path,a.attribute_kind||':'||a.attribute_start||':'||a.attribute_end,a.id FROM attributes a
 UNION SELECT c.__path,c.callee_id,c.id FROM calls c
 UNION SELECT c.__path,a.id,c.id FROM calls c JOIN arguments a ON a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id
 UNION SELECT c.__path,k.value,c.id FROM calls c JOIN keywords k ON k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id
 UNION SELECT n.__path,c.id,n.id FROM nodes n JOIN nodes c ON c.__path=n.__path AND c.parent=n.id AND c.ordinal=0 WHERE n.kind IN ('subscript','parenthesized_expression')

stages.name: user_callable
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE shaped(__path,id) AS (SELECT __path,id FROM nodes WHERE kind='lambda' OR kind='identifier' AND rx_matches(lower(text),'callable|callback|decoder|fn|function|hook|mapper|picker|processor|projector|row_decoder|transform') UNION SELECT s.__path,e.dst FROM shaped s JOIN callable_edges e ON e.__path=s.__path AND e.src=s.id) SELECT * FROM shaped

stages.name: legacy_postops
stages.query: SELECT k.* FROM keywords k JOIN compiled c ON c.__path=k.__path AND c.id=k.call WHERE k.name IN ('post_op','post_op_with_refs') AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM relaxed r WHERE r.__path=k.__path) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN nodes p ON p.__path=a.__path AND p.id=a.parent JOIN nodes root ON root.__path=p.__path AND root.id=p.parent AND root.kind='module' WHERE a.__path=k.__path AND a.target_text='CLOSED_POST_OP_STRICT' AND a.expr_kind='true' AND a.type_start IS NULL))

stages.name: legacy_callbacks
stages.query: SELECT k.__path,k.keyword,f.id FROM legacy_postops k JOIN functions f ON f.__path=k.__path AND f.name=k.text WHERE k.kind='identifier' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM functions newer WHERE newer.__path=f.__path AND newer.name=f.name AND newer.__start>f.__start)

stages.name: edges
stages.query: SELECT __path,src_kind||':'||src_start||':'||src_end AS src,src_start,src_end,src_kind,src_text,dst_kind||':'||dst_start||':'||dst_end AS dst,dst_start,dst_end,dst_kind,dst_text FROM positional_edges UNION SELECT __path,src_kind||':'||src_start||':'||src_end AS src,src_start,src_end,src_kind,src_text,dst_kind||':'||dst_start||':'||dst_end AS dst,dst_start,dst_end,dst_kind,dst_text FROM keyword_edges UNION SELECT __path,src_kind||':'||src_start||':'||src_end AS src,src_start,src_end,src_kind,src_text,dst_kind||':'||dst_start||':'||dst_end AS dst,dst_start,dst_end,dst_kind,dst_text FROM container_edges UNION SELECT __path,src_kind||':'||src_start||':'||src_end AS src,src_start,src_end,src_kind,src_text,dst_kind||':'||dst_start||':'||dst_end AS dst,dst_start,dst_end,dst_kind,dst_text FROM dictionary_edges UNION SELECT __path,src_kind||':'||src_start||':'||src_end AS src,src_start,src_end,src_kind,src_text,dst_kind||':'||dst_start||':'||dst_end AS dst,dst_start,dst_end,dst_kind,dst_text FROM spread_edges

stages.name: nodes
stages.query: SELECT __path,id,start,end,kind,max(text) AS text FROM (SELECT DISTINCT __path,src AS id,src_start AS start,src_end AS end,src_kind AS kind,src_text AS text FROM edges UNION SELECT DISTINCT __path,dst,dst_start,dst_end,dst_kind,dst_text FROM edges UNION SELECT __path,'call:'||__start||':'||__end,__start,__end,'call','' FROM calls UNION SELECT __path,value_kind||':'||value_start||':'||value_end,value_start,value_end,value_kind,value_text FROM returns UNION SELECT __path,value_kind||':'||value_start||':'||value_end,value_start,value_end,value_kind,value_text FROM bindings) GROUP BY __path,id,start,end,kind

stages.name: contexts
stages.query: SELECT n.__path,n.id,f.__start AS fn FROM nodes n JOIN functions f ON f.__path=n.__path AND f.__start<=n.start AND f.__end>=n.end

stages.name: locals
stages.query: SELECT __path,fn,name,value FROM (SELECT f.__path,f.__start AS fn,b.name,b.value_kind||':'||b.value_start||':'||b.value_end AS value,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY f.__path,f.__start,b.name ORDER BY b.__start DESC) AS selected FROM functions f JOIN bindings b ON b.__path=f.__path AND b.__start>f.__start AND b.__end<=f.__end) WHERE selected=1

stages.name: flows
stages.query: SELECT e.__path,ctx.fn,e.src,e.dst FROM edges e JOIN contexts ctx ON ctx.__path=e.__path AND ctx.id=e.dst UNION SELECT n.__path,c.fn,b.value,n.id FROM nodes n JOIN contexts c ON c.__path=n.__path AND c.id=n.id JOIN locals b ON b.__path=c.__path AND b.fn=c.fn AND b.name=n.text WHERE n.kind='identifier'

stages.name: consumers
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE reaching(__path,fn,id) AS (
 SELECT c.__path,ctx.fn,'call:'||c.__start||':'||c.__end FROM calls c JOIN contexts ctx ON ctx.__path=c.__path AND ctx.id='call:'||c.__start||':'||c.__end WHERE c.refs IS NOT NULL
 UNION SELECT r.__path,r.fn,e.dst FROM reaching r JOIN flows e ON e.__path=r.__path AND e.fn=r.fn AND e.src=r.id 
 UNION SELECT r.__path,ctx.fn,'call:'||c.__start||':'||c.__end FROM reaching r JOIN returns ret ON ret.__path=r.__path AND ret.fn=r.fn AND ret.value_kind||':'||ret.value_start||':'||ret.value_end=r.id JOIN functions f ON f.__path=ret.__path AND f.__start=ret.fn JOIN calls c ON c.__path=f.__path AND c.full_callee=f.name JOIN contexts ctx ON ctx.__path=c.__path AND ctx.id='call:'||c.__start||':'||c.__end
 ) SELECT * FROM reaching

stages.name: refless
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE reaching(__path,fn,id) AS (
 SELECT c.__path,ctx.fn,'call:'||c.__start||':'||c.__end FROM calls c JOIN contexts ctx ON ctx.__path=c.__path AND ctx.id='call:'||c.__start||':'||c.__end WHERE c.callee='runtime_refs_post_op' AND c.refs IS NULL
